source: Money Rooms v3 spec, Engine defaults

labels.retirementAgeDefault: Retirement age if Life plan is blank
labels.socialSecurityScale: Social Security, share of scheduled benefit
labels.housingShareOfTakeHome: Housing share of take-home: the comfortable line for rent or the full cost of owning, and the shelter-heavy flag (my default)
labels.hiddenLeakShare: Hidden leak above this share of take-home
labels.utilizationCardMax: Utilization drag above this on one card
labels.utilizationTotalMax: Utilization drag above this in total
labels.feeDragEr: Fee drag above this expense ratio
labels.thinRunwayMonths: Thin runway below this many months
labels.lockedLiquidityShare: Locked up below this liquid share
labels.realWageShare: Real wage flag below this share of stated
labels.baristaIncomeAnnualCents: Barista FI part-time income a year
labels.fiProgressBasis: FI progress counts: invested assets or net worth
labels.fiSpendingBasis: FI spending basis: actual lines, gut guess or dream
labels.healthcarePremiumMonthlyCents: Health premium a month before 65, estimate
labels.inflation: Inflation assumed (returns above are already after it)
labels.guardrailsBand: Guardrails: withdrawal rate may drift this share of its start
labels.ssBridgeFromPortfolio: Social Security floor: bridge years come from the portfolio
labels.showBenchmarksToClient: Show benchmarks in the client view
labels.callTargetRoomFraction: Meet in the middle: share of the way from actual toward the nearer of gut and dream
labels.fillGapsWithGuesses: Fill gaps with averages for the cost area
labels.roommateMonthsToReplace: Months until a roommate is replaced (cushion and worst case)
labels.cushionStep1: Cushion step 1, the lean month: one month of food, housing and getting around, or a fixed amount set on the Goals screen
labels.cushionStep2Months: Cushion step 2, the full month: months of all spending
